scope: Pure bounded PSST 1/12 receipt decoding and explicit structural-boundary qualification. Proposed protocol; no new image admitted by PPU IIO clients, no native calls, tickets submitted, hardware access or deployment.

contract.semantic_checks: Explicit nonzero u32 expected ticket; matching accepted/terminal tickets; terminal, nonpending, boundary complete, coarse disabled; no retained failure/rejected command. HAS_MAP requires generation1..0xfffffffe and exact representable [S,S+1280000). Empty history requires zero map generation and bounds.

independent_review.note: Reviewed original82 tests plus IIO/batches/control; exhaustive combination and cap cases then added as2 tracked tests.

working_tree_before_last_two_tests.note: Contains five unrelated dirty tests, excluded from commit.

limits: Decoder success is not firmware capability/geometry admission.
Structural completion is not fresh health, radio/boot/observation identity, kernel drain, host retention, PSS lock or GLRT agreement.
An old immutable success cannot substitute for a fresh receipt after a late fault or restart.
Returned bounds are nominal candidate coordinates, not full FFT input or live ADC/pilot coordinates.
No controller/kernel/IIO stop operation or paired recorder is implemented by this increment.
